title: Verbose patterns: manual loops where idioms exist

body.signal: Hand-rolled accumulation, manual index management, or verbose string building where a comprehension, builtin, or f-string expresses the same logic directly.
body.failure_mode: Long-winded code buries intent; each hand-rolled implementation is one more place for an off-by-one or misordered condition.
body.detection: AST pattern matching for known verbose idioms (accumulator loops, manual pluralization/formatting chains, index arithmetic).
body.fix_strategy: Rewrite with the idiomatic form. Gate: tests plus equivalence on the full input domain, including empty and boundary inputs.

provenance.note: Seeded from hand-authored/analyzed artifacts; promoted by human decision, not agent replay.

counterfactual.evidence: N/A for seeds - promoted by human authorship at engine bootstrap.
